maddeler.e:
أنتثر (form VIII)
# أَنْتَثِرُ (ʔantaṯiru) /ʔan.ta.θi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَثَرَ (intaṯara)
# أَنْتَثِرَ (ʔantaṯira) /ʔan.ta.θi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَثَرَ (intaṯara)
# أَنْتَثِرْ (ʔantaṯir) /ʔan.ta.θir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَثَرَ (intaṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
